user.title: Set up HomePod sensors
user.description: Add temperature and humidity sensors from your HomePods to Home Assistant. You can also enable automatic recovery if sensor access is lost.

devices.title: Select HomePods
devices.description: Select the HomePods you want to add. HomePods already managed by HomePod Sensor Link are hidden. Existing Home Assistant sensor entities and their history are preserved.

policy.title: Recovery per HomePod
policy.description: Recovery is selected by default. It requires a verified administrator credential for each selected device. Clear a device to use monitoring only.

credentials.title: Import controller credentials
credentials.description: Choose how to enter your authorised HomeKit controller credentials. Existing Apple Home pairings are preserved.

menu_options.credential_export: Paste a CSV or JSON export

manage.title: Choose a HomePod
manage.description: Select a HomePod to see its available actions.

menu_options.credentials: Import pairing export to find missing devices

reauth_confirm.title: Verify recovery credentials
reauth_confirm.description: Continue from an authenticated local administrator session to re-import the existing pinned controller identity. Reauthentication cannot replace an identity pin or bypass pairing safety limits. Other ready devices keep working.

credential_export.title: Paste credential export
credential_export.description: Open your selected HAP CSV or JSON export in a text editor and paste its contents below. Only include the required HomeKit records (maximum 128 KiB). The text is visible while you edit it. Raw exports stay in memory and are not saved as uploaded files. Address hints in pairing JSON trigger fresh discovery; review the discovered devices before continuing setup.

credential_manual.title: Enter controller credentials
credential_manual.description: Enter the existing controller identifier and its 64-character hexadecimal private key. New sensor access also requires the accessory identifier and pinned public key (64 hexadecimal characters). When adopting an existing native HomeKit entry, both accessory fields may be left empty. A HomeKit setup code is insufficient.

no_devices.title: No HomePods found
no_devices.description:
No HomePods are available to add. HomePods already managed by HomePod Sensor Link are hidden.

Make sure your HomePods are powered on and Home Assistant can reach them on the local network. Their HomeKit sensor service must be discoverable; appearing as an AirPlay player is not enough.

Search again, or import a pairing export with local address hints to help find missing HomePods.

discovery_failed.title: Could not search for HomePods
discovery_failed.description:
The search could not complete. Check the local network connection and try again.

Make sure your HomePods are powered on and Home Assistant can reach them on the local network. Their HomeKit sensor service must be discoverable; appearing as an AirPlay player is not enough.

Search again, or import a pairing export with local address hints to help find missing HomePods.

manage_actions.title: Manage HomePod
manage_actions.description:
**{name}**

Choose an action for this HomePod.

menu_option_descriptions.manage_resume: Run checks, then continue pending setup.
menu_option_descriptions.manage_recovery_on: Allow recovery if sensor access is lost.
menu_option_descriptions.manage_remove: Review what will be removed before continuing.

manage_resume.title: Resume setup?
manage_resume.description:
**{name}**

Resume may write a pending HomeKit pairing after identity and access checks pass.

manage_cancel.title: Cancel setup?
manage_cancel.description:
**{name}**

Pause all setup activity for this HomePod. You can resume it later.

manage_recovery_on.title: Enable automatic recovery?
manage_recovery_on.description:
**{name}**

Enable automatic recovery if sensor access is lost. Verified administrator credentials are required; you may be asked to import them.

manage_recovery_off.title: Disable automatic recovery?
manage_recovery_off.description:
**{name}**

Stop automatic recovery for this HomePod. Sensor monitoring remains enabled.

manage_remove.title: Remove this HomePod?
manage_remove.description:
**{name}**

Delete this HomePod’s local credentials and recovery history. This does not revoke its HomeKit pairings or remove its native Home Assistant entries.

data.confirm: I understand that local credentials and recovery history will be deleted.

progress.verify: Matching selected HomePods and authorised credentials. Pairing identities are saved before any later provisioning write.

error.discovery_failed: Discovery could not complete. Retry after checking local connectivity.
error.select_devices: Select one or more discovered or retained devices.
error.safety_blocked: Identity or permission validation blocked this device. Investigate the mismatch; Resume cannot replace its pinned identity.
error.device_action_failed: The device action did not complete. Local state was kept or cleanup remains pending. Check protected storage and connectivity before retrying.
error.invalid_credential_export: The credentials could not be read. Check the CSV/JSON format, controller identifier and private key, and accessory identifier/public key. Include both accessory fields or leave both empty. Exports must be at most 128 KiB. Enter the credentials again to retry.
error.confirm_removal: Confirm that you want to delete this HomePod’s local credentials and recovery history.

abort.local_admin_required: Use an authenticated Home Assistant administrator on the local network. Cloud and remote imports are not accepted.
abort.already_configured: HomePod Sensor Link is already configured. Use Reconfigure to add or manage devices.
abort.invalid_selection: The selected device is not part of this setup.
abort.verification_failed: No selected device could be prepared. Check the local HAP export, pins and connectivity.
abort.runtime_unavailable: Load the integration before managing devices.
abort.reauth_not_required: These monitoring-only devices do not need an administrator credential. Use Reconfigure to manage them.
abort.reauth_successful: The existing pinned administrator credentials were verified.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The selected HomePods have been added to HomePod Sensor Link.

check_now.name: Check sensor access now
check_now.description: Run the normal sensor access check now. Enabled recovery, pending setup and native reloads still require all persisted safeguards; this action does not bypass limits.

check_recovery_access.name: Check recovery administrator access
check_recovery_access.description: Read-only administrator audit for recovery-enabled devices. Returns anonymous health state without keys or pairing identifiers.

not_loaded.message: HomePod Sensor Link is not loaded. Load the integration before running this action.

check_failed.message: The HomePod check could not complete. Review the Sensor access diagnostic and Repairs. No limits were bypassed.

unreachable.message: All configured HomePods are unreachable. Check local connectivity; Home Assistant will retry setup.

unsupported_configuration.message: This configuration version is unsupported. Use a fresh HomePod Sensor Link entry.

engine_conflict.message: Another recovery engine is configured or still running. Resolve the competing integration before retrying.

setup_failed.message: HomePod setup or protected data validation failed. Check the private storage and configured identity pins; no pairing changes were authorised.

sensor_access.title: HomePod sensor access needs attention
sensor_access.description: A monitored HomePod could not verify sensor access. Check the Sensor access diagnostic and Reconfigure this integration. Identity or permission mismatches require investigation; Resume does not replace a pinned identity. Network failures never authorise pairing changes.

administrator_access.title: HomePod recovery administrator access needs attention
administrator_access.description: A recovery-enabled HomePod could not verify its pinned administrator credential. Sensor access may still work. Use Reconfigure to review the device and re-import the same authorised identity if needed. A read-only audit retries in one hour; this audit changes no pairings.

checks_unavailable.title: HomePod monitoring could not complete
checks_unavailable.description: Check the integration’s protected storage and local connectivity, then reload the integration. Keep existing credential files and safety history intact. Do not make permissions public or remove identity pins to bypass the failure.

engine_conflict.title: Another HomePod recovery engine is configured
engine_conflict.description: Use only one recovery engine. Stop or disable the conflicting helper through its own supported process, then retry HomePod Sensor Link setup. Old credentials and state are never migrated or removed by this integration.

monitoring_stalled.title: HomePod Sensor Link monitoring has stalled
monitoring_stalled.description: One or more HomePods have no completed sensor check in at least 15 minutes. Review the Sensor access diagnostics and reload the integration if monitoring remains stalled. This alert makes no pairing changes and clears when checks resume. Intentional pauses and devices awaiting credentials are excluded.
